cases.headline: Canara Bank is beating the market today. Buy only if it breaks above its morning high of 134.3, with a tight stop.
cases.bull:
**Bull case (long CANBK):** The setup is decent but the plan as written is poor, so I'd change it.

**Evidence:** The stock opened 132.3 (gap -0.08%) and ran to a 134.3 high within three bars, a +1.24% move against an index at +0.18%. Relative volume is 1.76, and the first two real bars (1.83M, 1.10M) closed at 134.15 and 133.94, near the highs. It sits above the previous high of 133.89 and well above the 20-day average of 122.27, so the trend is up.

**Entry:** Buy a break and 5-minute close above 134.3 (the OR high). The scanner's trigger of 134.37 is fine, but only 0.07 higher. Price is 133.94, just under VWAP at 134.07, so a hold above VWAP is a minimum.

**Stop:** The scanner's 132.2 stop is 2.17 away, about 2.6x ATR, so Rs 500 of risk buys roughly 230 shares. That is too wide for a quick breakout. I'd use a tighter stop under 133.85 (the previous high / VWAP zone), about 0.5 risk. That cuts the cost drag to a smaller share of risk.

**Target:** The 138.7 target is 4.3 away, about 5x ATR, unrealistic intraday. Aim for about 135.8-136.2, roughly 2x ATR.

**Wrong if:** price loses VWAP and 133.89 on volume, or the breakout stalls with fading volume. Only three bars exist, so confidence is low.
cases.bear:
**Rebuttal:** The Bull calls the first two bars "near the highs," but 09:25 closed at 133.94, well off its 134.3 high, and volume fell from 1.83M to 1.10M. That is fading volume on the test of the OR high. Price is below VWAP (134.071), so the "above" case is unproven. Relative volume of 1.76 comes from only three bars, one with zero volume, so it's weak evidence. The 20-day average of 122.27 is irrelevant to the next hour; the stock is 9.5% above it, which is extension, not support. The proposed stop under 133.85 is about 0.09 below price, roughly 0.1x ATR (0.83). That is noise-level, and costs of about a quarter of risk would be far worse than the Bull admits. The 2x ATR target against that stop is fantasy.

**Bear case:** The first 09:15 bar rallied 132.2 to 133.7, and the move has stalled at 134.3, with a rejection wick on 09:25 (high 134.3, close 133.94). Index is only +0.18%, so no strong tailwind.

**Short trigger:** 5-minute close below 133.80 (under the 09:25 low and just above the previous high of 133.89... so require a close below 133.80 only on rising volume).

**Stop:** 134.40, about 0.6 risk, 1.0 ATR.

**Target:** 132.90, about 1.3 ATR.

Honestly, with three bars, staying out is the better call.

judge.title: CANBK: conditional long on a break of the 134.3 opening-range high
judge.text: The stock is up 1.24% against an index up only 0.18%. It is trading above yesterday's high of 133.89, and relative volume is 1.76x, so this is genuine relative strength. A stop entry at 134.37 only fills if that strength resumes. The Bear's points are real and keep conviction at 2. The 09:25 bar hit 134.3 and closed at 133.94, below VWAP at 134.07, and volume fell from 1.83M to 1.10M. I also reject both plans' stops: the scanner's 132.2 is 2.17 away, about 2.6x the 0.83 ATR, and the Bull's 133.85 is noise-tight. I use 133.6 instead, under the 09:20 low of 133.65 (0.77 risk, 0.57%), with a 135.6 target (1.6x risk). That keeps a fill from being eaten by costs, though with only three bars and my 4 past calls (n is tiny) this is a small, conditional bet.

cases.headline: Eicher Motors is firm but has only three bars of history and sits right on its average price, so we wait.
cases.bull:
Case for long: EICHERMOT gapped up 0.83% (open 7662 vs prev close 7599) and held it. The first three bars show higher lows (7645.5, 7668, 7706) and the last close is 7716.5, just 0.16% under the opening-range high of 7729. Price sits above VWAP (7713.5, barely), relvol is 1.62, and the stock is up 0.71% against an index up 0.18%. It is also well above its 20-day average (7372.6).

Entry: only on a break of 7732.86, the scanner trigger, ideally a 5-minute close above 7729 with volume at or above the 23k-per-bar pace. Don't buy ahead of the break.

Stop: the plan puts it at 7645.5, the OR low. That is 87 points of risk, about 1.8x ATR5 (48), which is wide. A tighter stop below 7706 (last bar's low) risks about 27 points, but it is noise-sized. Size by Rs 500 risk: roughly 5 shares at the wide stop.

Target: the plan's 7907.59 is about 175 points away (2R), and it sits near yesterday's high of 7947, which is resistance. A realistic target is 7850-7900.

Wrong if: price closes back under VWAP (~7713), volume fades, or it loses 7706. Honestly, the edge is thin: only three bars so far, and the trigger is barely above the current price.
cases.bear:
Rebuttal: The Bull's own concessions carry the argument. The "opening range" is just three bars, and the first bar has zero volume, so the range and relvol of 1.62 rest on two real bars (23,768 and 23,299). Volume is already flat-to-down, not building. "Above VWAP" is 7716.5 vs 7713.5, a 3-point gap, so it is effectively at VWAP and not a trend signal. Higher lows over three bars is noise. The gap-up holding is weak too: the first bar spiked to 7716.5, and the last close is exactly that level, so the stock has gone nowhere in 10 minutes. The wide 87-point stop (1.8x ATR5) gives poor sizing, and 7947 yesterday's high caps the move.

Short case: a failed break is plausible, but there is no real evidence of one yet. The honest verdict is mostly stay out. A short only triggers on a 5-minute close below 7706 (last bar low), which would also be below VWAP. Stop 7732 (above OR high), about 26 points of risk. Target 7668 (second bar low), about 1.4R. Costs near a quarter of risk make that marginal. I prefer no trade until more bars form.

judge.title: No trade: EICHERMOT: relative strength, but too early and too thin to pay after costs
judge.text: The Bull has real points: the stock is up 0.71% against an index up 0.18%, has relvol 1.62 and has higher lows of 7645.5, 7668 and 7706, with the last close 7716.5 just under the 7729 opening-range high. The Bear's rebuttal decides it. The range rests on two real bars (23,768 and 23,299 volume, with the first bar showing 0), so volume is flat rather than building. Price is only 3 points above VWAP (7713.5), and the rule stop at 7645.5 is 87 points, about 1.8x ATR5 of 48, which makes the risk too wide for a reliable 2R before yesterday's 7947 high. A tighter version (trigger 7733, stop 7700 under VWAP and the 7706 bar low, target 7800, about 2R) is the trade I would score. With costs near a quarter of risk and only 4 past calls (the refused rule trades averaged +0.06R), the edge looks too marginal to take.

cases.headline: GRASIM is testing its morning high, but the push is losing volume and is already stretched, so we stay out.
cases.bull:
**Bull case (long GRASIM):** Price is 3045.90, right at the opening-range high of 3045.70, after four straight higher closes (3024.5, 3029.8, 3037.9, 3045.9). Relative volume is 2.52, so participation is real. Price sits 13.4 above VWAP (3032.47) and above the 20-day average (3012.12), and the index is up 0.23%. Today's low equals the open (3012.3), so buyers have held every dip.

**Entry:** Take the scanner's trigger at 3047.42 only on a 5-minute close above it, not a wick. Chasing the current price gains little.

**Stop:** The scanner stop at 3012.3 is 35 points away, about 2 ATRs (atr5 17.0). That is wide. On Rs 500 risk it allows about 14 shares, roughly Rs 43k notional. A tighter, more honest stop is just under VWAP, about 3030, which is 17 points (one ATR) and allows about 29 shares.

**Target:** The scanner's 3117.67 is 70 points away and sits near yesterday's high of 3125. Reaching it before 15:15 is a stretch. A realistic target is 3075-3080, about 1.7-2R off the VWAP stop.

**Wrong if:** price closes back below VWAP (~3032) or back inside the range. The last bar's volume of 4,104 was thin, so a failed breakout is also a warning sign.
cases.bear:
**Rebuttals.** The four higher closes are real, but they come from only four bars, and the 09:15 bar alone made the whole range (3012.3 to 3045.7). The opening range is just one 5-minute bar, so "breaking out" of it means little. Relative volume of 2.52 is mostly that opening bar (14,446); the 09:30 bar had only 4,104, the thinnest of the four, so the push to 3045.9 came on fading volume. The Bull concedes this. "Buyers held every dip" is thin: the low is the open, and price has made only one dip. The VWAP stop at 3030 is only 15.9 below, under one ATR (17.0), so ordinary noise can hit it, and costs are about a quarter of risk.

**Case for staying out or shorting.** Price is 13.4 above VWAP, nearly one ATR of extension, and it sits exactly at the range high with no close above 3047.42 yet. Yesterday's high of 3125 and the 3034 prior close add little overhead, but the day gapped down 0.72% and has only just filled the gap.

**Short plan (low conviction):** Trigger only on a 5-minute close below 3029.8, the 09:20 close, which is near VWAP. Stop 3047.5, about 18 points. Target 3012.3, the day low, about 17 points, roughly 1R. That is too marginal after costs, so my honest call is to stay out unless the long fails first.

judge.title: No trade: GRASIM: breakout attempt on fading volume, pass
judge.text: The Bull's points are real. There are four higher closes (3024.5 to 3045.9), relative volume is 2.52, price is above VWAP (3032.47) and the 20-day average (3012.12), and the index is up 0.23%. The Bear's rebuttal decides it. The opening range is a single bar (3012.3 to 3045.7) that carried most of the volume (14,446), and the move to the high came on the thinnest bar of the day (4,104). Price already sits 13.4 points above VWAP, close to one ATR (17.0), so a sensible stop under VWAP at 3030 is only about one ATR away and can be hit by ordinary noise. That leaves a long at 3047.42 with a 3078 target (about 1.75R), which is a marginal edge once costs take roughly a quarter of the risk; the Bear's short is even weaker at about 1R, so we pass.

cases.headline: Coal India is weak today, but the drop already happened and the setup is too thin to pay after costs, so we stay out.
cases.bull:
Honest case for a long is thin, and I'd say so up front.

The argument: COALINDIA sold off hard in the first bar (403.0 to 398.4 on 563,375 shares), then stopped falling. The next three bars held above 398.1 (day low 398.1, last 398.95), with lows of 398.4, 398.1, 398.35. Selling momentum faded: volume dropped from 563k to 32k, and the index is up 0.23%. Price sits at 398.95, essentially at VWAP (399.065), so a reclaim is cheap to test.

Entry: a 5-minute close above 399.6 (above VWAP and the 09:20 high of 399.55). Stop: below 398.1, the day low, about 1.5 points risk, so roughly 330 shares at Rs 500 risk. Target: 401.5, near the gap-fill zone and midway to the OR high of 403.0, about 1.7x risk. Beyond that, 403.0 is the stretch.

Against me: price is below the 20DMA (402.85), the open of 403.0 is the day high, and relvol is 2.19 driven by the sell bar. With ATR5 at 1.84, costs eat a quarter of risk, so the edge is marginal.

Wrong if: price loses 398.1 or fails to hold VWAP on the first retest.
cases.bear:
Rebuttals: The Bull's "selling faded" point is really just a drop from one huge opening bar; 32k on the 09:30 bar is a partial bar, so it says little. The bounce is also tiny: the highs are 399.55, 399.0, 398.95, all under VWAP (399.065), so there is no reclaim yet. "Gap-fill" is wrong: the gap is only -0.12%, and 401.5 sits well above every post-open high. The index at +0.23% is mild support, but COALINDIA is falling against it (-1.0%), which is relative weakness. The Bull concedes price is below the 20DMA (402.85) and the open was the day high.

Bear case: open equals day high at 403.0, and price is capped below VWAP and the 20DMA, with yesterday's low (402.3) now overhead as resistance. But price is sitting 0.1 above the day low, and the range is only 4.9 points, so the move is already done and chasing is poor.

Short trigger: 5-minute close below 398.1 (the day low). The scanner's 397.9 is fine. Stop: 399.7, just above VWAP and the 09:20 high, about 1.8 risk, rather than the scanner's 403.0, which is far too wide. Target: 395.5, about 2R. Given the thin edge and costs, staying out until 398.1 breaks is preferable.

judge.title: No trade: COALINDIA: relative weakness is real, but the edge left is too thin to short
judge.text: The Bear wins on direction. Coal India is down 1.0% while the index is up 0.23%, it opened at its high of 403.0, and every bounce since (highs 399.55, 399.0, 398.95) has stalled at or below VWAP (399.065), so the Bull's long has no reclaim to stand on. Against a short, almost the whole 4.9-point opening range came in the first bar on 563k shares, and the last three bars have gone flat above 398.1, so a break below 397.9 would be chasing a move that is largely finished. A sensible stop at 399.7 risks 1.8 points, about one ATR5 (1.84), and the 395.0 target needs another 1.5 ATR of follow-through; once costs take roughly a quarter of the risk, that is a marginal edge, which by our rules is a loss. If forced to trade, it would be the short at 397.9, stop 399.7, target 395.0, but no trade is the better call.

cases.headline: Hero MotoCorp is drifting up with the market, but its first breakout try failed and buying has dried up, so stay out.
cases.bull:
The case for long is modest but real. HEROMOTOCO opened at 5399.0, gapped up 0.26% over yesterday's close of 5385.0, and has held above yesterday's high of 5393.5 all session. It sits well above its 20-day average of 5270.4. Relative volume is 1.77, and the 09:20 bar, with 25,359 shares and a 5448.5 high, shows real buying. Price is 5438.0, above VWAP at 5432.9, and the index is up 0.23%, so it is not fighting the tape. The last bar, 09:30, closed at the high of the range on thin volume of 3,528.

Entry: the scanner's trigger of 5451.22 is only 13 points over the 5438 last price and just above the opening range high of 5448.5. I would wait for a 5-minute close above 5451 rather than anticipate it.

Stop: the plan puts it at 5399.0, about 52 points away, roughly 2 ATRs (ATR5 is 25.6). That is wide, so the size is about 9 shares for Rs 500 risk. A tighter stop below VWAP, around 5420, is arguably more logical.

Target: the plan's 5555.67 is about 104 points away, which is ambitious. I would aim for about 5500 realistically.

Wrong if: price closes below VWAP (5432.9), or the 5-minute bar falls back inside the range under 5420. Note that the 09:25 bar already rejected 5447, so the edge is thin after costs.
cases.bear:
Rebuttals. The Bull's "held above yesterday's high" is true (day low 5399.0 vs 5393.5), but the margin is only 5.5 points, and price opened at the day low, so it is barely a support test. The 5448.5 high on the 09:20 bar was the opening range top, and the 09:25 bar rejected 5447.0 and closed at 5422.0. That is a failed push, not clean buying. The Bull says the last bar closed at its high, but it is on 3,528 shares against 25,359 at the peak, so the volume is down about 86%. Price is only 5.1 points above VWAP, which is a small cushion. The Bull's tighter 5420 stop is under 1 ATR (25.6), so noise will likely hit it.

Short case: weak, and I would mostly stay out. The index is up 0.23%, which argues against fighting the tape. Still, there is a double-top feel near 5447-5448.5 on fading volume.

Conditional short: trigger on a 5-minute close below 5420, which is under the 09:25 low of 5420.0 and VWAP. Stop 5449. Target 5399. That is 21 points of reward for 29 of risk, a poor ratio after costs. My recommendation is to stay out.

judge.title: No trade: HEROMOTOCO: thin breakout edge, pass
judge.text: The long case has real support: price is 5438.0, just above VWAP at 5432.9; the day low of 5399.0 is above yesterday's high of 5393.5; relative volume is 1.77; and the index is up 0.23%. Against it, the 09:20 push to 5448.5 was rejected on the 09:25 bar, which closed at 5422.0. The bounce back to 5438 came on only 3,528 shares, against 25,359 on the peak bar, so buying is fading into the range top. The scanner's stop at 5399.0 is about 52 points (roughly 2 ATR) and its 5555.67 target is ambitious, while a tighter 5420 stop sits barely more than 1 ATR (25.6) away, so either version leaves a marginal edge that costs of about a quarter of the risk would erase. If forced to trade, I would go long on a break of 5451.5 with a stop at 5420 and a target of 5499, but the failed first test and drying volume make this a pass.

cases.headline: Britannia is sitting right on its morning low; a breakdown short is possible, but the reward barely covers costs, so we stay out.
cases.bull:
Honest case for a long is thin, and I'll say so up front.

The bull argument: price is sitting at 4723.9, right on the opening-range low of 4722.0 (it was defended twice, at 09:25 and 09:30, with lows of exactly 4722.0). That's a possible double-bottom. The 20-day average is 4730.09, so price is just under it, and the index is up 0.23% while BRITANNIA is down 0.76%, which leaves room for mean reversion. Selling volume is also fading: 8110, 5569, then 2075.

Entry: only on a confirmed bounce, say a 5-minute close above 4731 (reclaiming the 20DMA). The stop goes below 4722, around 4716, so risk is about 15 points, which keeps size workable. Realistic target: VWAP at 4744.8, about 14 points above entry. That's roughly 1R before costs, and costs eat about a quarter of that.

What proves me wrong: any 5-minute close below 4722. Also, the trend is down from the 4789.5 high, price is below VWAP, and relative volume of 1.75 favors sellers. Only four bars exist, so this is a weak setup. I'd pass unless the reclaim happens.
cases.bear:
Rebuttals: The double-bottom is two bars with identical lows of 4722.0, which is thin evidence, and the last bar's range (4722.0 to 4730.9) is only 8.9 points against an ATR of 25.8. That is compression, not a reversal. Fading volume (8110, 5569, 2075) shows selling exhaustion, but it also just reflects the usual opening burst fading. The 20DMA at 4730.09 is 6 points away, which is noise. Index up 0.23% while the stock is down 0.76% shows relative weakness, not a bounce signal. The Bull's target of 4744.8 is about 1R, and costs take a quarter of that, so the edge is marginal.

Short case: the stock reversed from 4789.5 to 4723.9, closing below the open (4760.3) and VWAP (4744.8). It opened near prev_close and failed under prev_hi of 4810.

But the scanner's plan is poor. Entry 4719.64 with a stop at 4789.5 risks about 70 points. The target of 4579.92 is 140 points away, about 5 ATRs, which is unrealistic. Only four bars exist.

My trade: short on a 5-minute close below 4722, entry about 4720. Stop 4745 (VWAP), 25 points risk. Target 4695, 1R. That is marginal after costs, so staying out is acceptable.

judge.title: No trade: BRITANNIA: OR-low breakdown short is too marginal, pass
judge.text: The bear side is the better side. The stock fell from 4789.5 to 4723.9, below VWAP (4744.8), below yesterday's low (4741.2) and below its 20DMA (4730.09). It is down 0.76% while the index is up 0.23%, and relative volume is 1.75. Even so, the trade does not pay: the scanner's 70-point stop and 140-point target (about 5 five-minute ATRs of 25.8) are unrealistic. A sensible VWAP stop of about 25 points allows only a roughly 1.5R target near 4681, and costs take about a quarter of R. The 4722.0 low has also held twice, and the last bar is a compressed 8.9-point range on fading volume (8110, 5569, 2075), so the breakdown could easily fail at support with only four bars of evidence. The bull's reclaim long gives about 1R into VWAP, which is worse, so neither side clears the cost hurdle and the verdict is NO_TRADE.
